clinic.title: Clinic
clinic.name: Clinic name
clinic.brandNameHelp: Optional. Fill this in if the name patients know you by differs from your registered legal name.
clinic.nameEnHelp: Optional. Used in emails written in English. Leave it empty and those emails carry your Georgian name.
clinic.addressEnHelp: Optional. Used in the same emails as the English clinic name.
clinic.emailHelp: The clinic's contact address — where we write to the practice. Not your sign-in email.
clinic.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, or leave the field empty.
clinic.taxId: Tax ID / VAT / Business Registration Number
clinic.taxIdPlaceholder: e.g., {example}, DE123456789, or local business ID
clinic.taxIdInvalid: Use letters, numbers, hyphens and spaces only.
clinic.taxIdInvalidGeDigits: A Georgian identification number contains digits only — remove any letters or symbols.
clinic.taxIdInvalidGeLength: A company identification code is exactly 9 digits; an individual entrepreneur's personal number is 11.
clinic.taxIdInvalidVat: Enter a valid VAT number for the selected country (e.g., DE123456789).
clinic.taxIdInvalidLength: Enter 5 to 15 characters — letters and numbers only.

clinic.companyRegistryUnavailable: The Public Registry is unavailable right now. Enter the details manually — this will not block your registration.
clinic.companyLookupThrottled: Too many lookups. Try again in a minute, or enter the details manually.

clinic.passwordShownOnce: Shown once — give this password to the doctor now.
clinic.noDoctorsYet: No doctors yet. They appear here automatically once you log a procedure and name the operating surgeon.
clinic.addDoctorHelp: Creates a login so this doctor can sign in. Doctors already appear in the list above from the procedures you record.
clinic.deleteAccountBlurb: Permanently delete this clinic account and everything in it.

clinic.patientConsents: I confirm that my clinic has obtained all patient consents required by Georgian law — including the patient's explicit consent to the processing of health data as special category data under the Law of Georgia on Personal Data Protection — before entering any personal or health information into this platform.

patient.personalData: I confirm that the patient has given explicit consent to the processing of their personal data for post-operative care, as required by the Law of Georgia on Personal Data Protection.
patient.healthData: I confirm that the patient has given EXPLICIT CONSENT to the processing of their health data as special category data under the Law of Georgia on Personal Data Protection.
patient.reminders: I confirm that the patient has agreed to receive reminder emails and notifications.

patient.corrections: I understand that I must immediately correct or update any inaccurate patient information upon notice.

The plan will still run, and their adherence will count doses they were never told about. Adding an email address first takes a moment.
carePlan.activateUnreachableSuppressed: Email to this patient has been stopped after a bounce or complaint, and they have no notifications enabled, so every reminder in this plan will be generated and marked handled without reaching them. The plan will still run.

privacy.title: Privacy and your data
privacy.intro: Under the Law of Georgia on Personal Data Protection and the Law of Georgia on the Rights of the Patient, you decide how your data is used. You can change your consent, take a copy of your record, or ask your clinic to correct or erase it.
privacy.consentHelp: You can withdraw either of these at any time. Withdrawing takes effect immediately and does not change your treatment or your care plan.
privacy.notGranted: Withdrawn — you are not receiving this
privacy.clinicalConsentNote: Consent to hold your medical record cannot be withdrawn here. Georgian law requires your clinic to keep clinical records for a fixed period. Use the erasure request below and your clinic will tell you what can be removed and what must be kept.
privacy.exportHelp: Download everything held about you — your details, your care plans, your reminders, your recovery logs and your consent history — as a single file you can keep or give to another clinic.
privacy.requestHelp: Your clinic answers these requests. You will see their reply here, including their reason if they cannot do what you asked.
privacy.requestDetailHint: Tell your clinic what is wrong, or anything they should know.
privacy.requestFailed: That did not send. Please try again.

dataRequests.heading: Patient data requests
dataRequests.help: Patients have asked you to correct or erase their data. Georgian law requires a written answer, including when the answer is no.
dataRequests.erasureNote: Completing this erases the patient's name, phone number, email address and notes. Their clinical record — care plans, reminders, recovery logs — is retained for the period the Law of Georgia on Health Care requires, and their allergies are kept so the record stays safe to read.
dataRequests.resolutionHint: Tell the patient what you did, or why you cannot.
